chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Al-Halby, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who copulated with his wife while she was menstruating. He (peace be upon him) said: 'If he had copulated with her during the beginning of the blood, let him seek the Forgiveness of Allah, and let him give in charity to seven persons from the Believers in a measurement of a provision for each man among them for his day, and he should not repeat. And if he had copulated with her at the declining of the blood, during the end of her days, before the washing, so there is nothing upon him.'

key_terms.فِي آخِرِ أَيَّامِهَا: At the end of her days (of menstruation)

ai.seo_question: What is the penalty for a man who has intercourse with his wife during her menstruation according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the fiqh of intercourse during menstruation by distinguishing between the early phase (istiqbal al-dam) and the late phase (idbar al-dam). While the early phase incurs a specific penalty of charity to seven believers, the late phase is considered free of penalty, reflecting the Shia scholarly view that the prohibition is strictly tied to the presence of blood. This distinction highlights the precision in Shia jurisprudence regarding the temporal boundaries of ritual impurity.
